note: Assessment criteria summary — written in own words from the published unit specification. The live assignment task wording is distributed in class by your teacher.

tasks.title: Research and scoping for the client brief

criteria.text: Demonstrate an adequate understanding of how relational database models, data storage and normalisation provide reliable data structures, using partially relevant examples.
Carry out adequate research to produce a preliminary scoping document that partially meets the client's requirements.
Demonstrate a good understanding of relational database models, data storage and normalisation, using mostly relevant examples.
Carry out mostly detailed research to produce a scoping document that considers most of the client's requirements.
Carry out effective research demonstrating thorough understanding of database principles, normalisation and how to comprehensively meet the client's requirements, using pertinent examples.
Produce a design and documentation that meets some of the client's requirements.
Produce a design and documentation that meets most of the client's requirements.
Produce a design and documentation that comprehensively meets the client's requirements.

tasks.title: Develop, test and optimise the database

criteria.text: Use tools, techniques, processes and testing to produce a database that meets some of the client's requirements.
Use tools, techniques, processes and testing to produce a database that meets most of the client's requirements.
Use tools, techniques, processes and testing to produce a database that comprehensively meets the client's requirements.

task1.Pass: Adequate understanding of database principles with partially relevant examples; a scoping document with some technical inaccuracies.
task1.Merit: In-depth analysis with mostly appropriate diagrams and relevant examples; a mostly technically accurate, well-communicated scoping document.
task1.Distinction: Clear, balanced evaluation of database principles and normalisation with pertinent examples; a scoping document with fluent, accurate technical vocabulary and well-structured reasoning.

task2.Pass: Basic use of design skills; a design specification, timescale and test plan that partially meet requirements.
task2.Merit: Good use of design skills; a design specification, timescale and test plan that meet most requirements.
task2.Distinction: Accomplished use of design skills; a design specification, timescale and test plan that comprehensively meet requirements.

task3.Pass: Basic use of tools and techniques to build a database that partially works; some object and usability testing.
task3.Merit: Good use of tools and techniques to build a functional database; appropriate object and usability testing.
task3.Distinction: Effective use of tools and techniques to build a fully functional database; effective testing and a thorough self-review leading to considered refinements.
